excerpt: BTS brought Mexico City to a standstill with three explosive sold-out nights of their BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG', turning the city into a festival-like celebration from 7 May to 10 May. The group's Mexico City run reportedly drew around 150,000 attendees, with local authorities estimating that tens of thousands more gathered outside the stadium on Days 2 and 3.

Zhao Lusi brought romance, warmth, and plenty of heartfelt moments to Bangkok on 9 May as the Chinese superstar staged her first-ever overseas solo concert at IMPACT Arena. The show transformed the venue into a dreamy escape, with fans joining the singer and actress for an evening built around love, connection, and shared memories.
